items.docs: Make partial changes to existing plans. The response returns whether each plan was successfully patched or not. When patching objects, we recommend that you first retrieve the object definition using `GET`. You can use the `GET` response in your `PATCH` request definition. To retrieve main plan or subplan IDs, see `GET /v1/planning/model/plans`. If the response includes a `parentPlanUuid`, then the plan is a subplan. params.name: planId
params.description: The unique identifier of the main plan or subplan. Use the main plan ID for consolidating, starting collaboration, or ending collaboration. Otherwise, use the subplan ID.

params.name: scenarioId
params.description: The unique identifier of the plan scenario.

items.docs:
Make partial changes to a scenario in an existing plan. The response returns whether the scenario was successfully patched or not. When patching objects, we recommend that you first retrieve the object definition using `GET`. You can use the `GET` response in your `PATCH` request definition. To retrieve plan IDs and scenario IDs, see `GET /v1/planning/model/plans`. If the response includes a `parentPlanUuid`, then the plan is a subplan.
